entries.origin_note: Codex chose availability, receiving allocation and affordable alternatives under the standing assignment. Retains actual Claude/Grok influence from the existing exchange; today's investigation is Codex-authored.
entries.title: Thursday: retain P-2 with chest, ankle and pressure qualifications
entries.question: Do Wednesday availability and allocation reports overturn the agreed nine, and what funded alternatives deserve attention?
entries.why_it_matters: Two selected receivers are limited; Titan receiving competition and Pittsburgh pressure personnel affect several slots without proving a replacement is better.
findings: Tyson chest LP and Meyers ankle LP are actual Wednesday entries; the latter ankle condition also appeared in the prior week's report.
Tate shoulder LP; Spears knee DNP. Saleh anticipates more Restrepo participation without committing to a snap/route allocation.
Herbig hip/ribs DNP differs from Watt/Heyward rest. Philadelphia Smith/Wicks LP, Barkley/McKee FP; no starting-QB announcement or Sunday clearance inferred.
Prescott, Pickens, Williams, Cook and LaPorta absent from inspected reports. Buffalo's session was a walk-through; absence from a list is not Sunday clearance.
All nine reported salary/position/opponent rows match. Sunday expected afternoon membership unchanged. No official pool export or coherent main model retrieved.
Prior Sunday complete; existing provisional scoring and Dak discrepancy retained without unsupported correction.
interpretation: Hold all nine. One midweek participation entry is insufficient by itself to reverse previously documented role evidence.
Restrepo's coach-backed opportunity deserves more weight than promotion alone, while still falling short of a reason to choose him over Ayomanor.
Pittsburgh's original pressure rationale is weaker conditionally, not invalidated; final personnel can materially change the choice.

alternatives.reason: Affordable response to meaningful Tyson restriction. Reintroduces Dallas's fourth player ($26,100 DAL; $29,800 TEN–DAL) and previously documented trailing-script concern; not preferred solely because Tyson logged one LP.

alternatives.disposition: decline today; reopen on role evidence
alternatives.reason: Spears knee DNP is new support for investigating Pollard, not proof of his absence. Existing reception-outlier concern remains. DAL falls to $13,500; TEN–DAL $23,700, still four players in that game. No unsupported workload or point gain asserted.

Thursday/Friday participation and Sunday game status
Tyson chest effect on actual routes/snaps
Philadelphia starter and receiver availability; Herbig participation
entries.lineup_effect: Unchanged exact P-2: $49,800 / $200; six games; Dallas three players $20,800, TEN–DAL four players $24,500. Not frozen.
change_triggers: Tyson worsening participation or an explicit chest-related workload restriction prompts comparison with Flournoy; one LP alone does not force exit.
Meyers worsening ankle participation or a workload restriction requires a funded FLEX alternative.
Tate's progression plus credible role redistribution, rather than Tate's mere return, reopens Ayomanor/Dike/Restrepo.
Herbig availability and Philadelphia QB/receiver/protection changes reopen the defense comparison.
Spears final availability and supported Pollard workload could reopen Williams/Pollard; DNP is not OUT.
Official slate or eligibility mismatch requires an explicit correction.
carry_forward: Distinguish injury DNP, rest DNP, limited participation and estimated/walk-through reports.
An existing ankle listing is not proof of new deterioration; a coach's plan for more involvement is not a full-time role guarantee.
Fund replacements as a whole lineup: Flournoy fits but increases Dallas concentration; Pollard saves money while retaining game concentration.
No repeat v1, unlimited question loop, invented provider participation or retrospective endorsement.

expectations.subject: Jordyn Tyson
expectations.statement: The provisional hold assumes the chest limitation will not materially restrict the passing-down opportunity underlying the selection; being active alone will not establish that this condition held.
expectations.support: Prior archived Week 10 target/snap role; current Saints report lists chest LP rather than an absence.
expectations.uncertainty: One-game role sample, Olave competition, and no Thursday/Friday status or workload guidance.
expectations.challenge: Worsening participation or an explicit restriction would undermine the hold before freeze; a reduced game role may contradict the condition afterward.
expectations.observe: Compare final injury status, available snap/route participation and targets with the cited prior role, separating health evidence from game script. If causal health evidence is absent, cause remains unassessable.
